_commentFolder: This file is the core of the configuration folder (PLAN.md §3.6, Q78): the classification taxonomy lives in classification.json, label stocks in labels/stocks/<id>.json, yearly calendars in calendar.<year>.json, templates in {cards,labels,slips}/templates/<name>/. Fragments win over the same keys here.

school._comment: Phase 12 (Q94): the levels of the school in order, grouped in stages, from the preset it-primaria (config/school-presets/). The classes themselves (1 A, 3 B, the teachers group) are data, created in Administration → Classes.

catalog._comment: Q73: author and publisher are mandatory; these special values are offered as quick picks when there is no personal author or the publisher/place is unknown.

inventory._comment: 9.64 (Q155): the school inventory, off by default. On, a copy has its inventory number (the next one proposed), its origin from this list and its value in euro; the reports list the copies entered and withdrawn in a period.

barcodes._comment: Phase 12 (Q90-Q93): new copies YYYY-CNNNN and new cards CNNNNNN with a mod-23 check letter (2026-E0267, U012345). The codes of the old system keep working: copies YYYY-NNNN, cards of 10 digits, plain numbers up to plainMaxLength digits [VERIFY at the Koha migration].

circulation._commentRules: Q13 resolved: students 15 days / 1 loan / 5 renewals, teachers 15 days / 4 loans / 5 renewals. Q68: DVDs 5 days and 1 renewal, whoever borrows them.

metadata._comment: Q26 resolved: only the public OPAC SBN Z39.50 service by default. Optional providers: openlibrary, googlebooks, sbn-json (undocumented mobile gateway).

performance._comment: Q22, step 9.28: micro = one slow core and 512 MB; small = Raspberry Pi 4 with 2 GB and SD card (default); medium = old PC with a spinning hard disk; large = PC with plenty of RAM and SSD. Any key below overrides the profile default (the values of each profile: src/lib/shared/performance.ts).

cards._comment: Defaults reproduce the library's current cards (docs/reference/cards): four units per A4, crop marks in the margins and gaps, one template for every patron type.

labels._commentStocks: Adhesive stocks live one per file in labels/stocks/<id>.json (Q78): copy a file to add a new stock.

photos._comment: enabled: false switches patron photos off altogether (9.38). Step 3.11: every patron photo is stored at exactly width × height (cropped at the centre when the browser has not cropped it) in `format` (jpeg or webp) with `quality` 1–100. required: false hides every reminder that photos are missing (they can still be taken and printed).

sheet._comment: Phase 13: pictures with many faces for the photo census (the photographer's sheet, the class's cards on a table). maxUploadBytes: the largest file accepted; maxPixels: the longest side kept; maxFrames: at most this many photos per picture; minAspect / maxAspect: the height / width of a photo frame.

covers._commentFormat: enabled: false switches book covers off altogether (9.38). Step 3.11: covers keep their proportions (never cropped): `width` in pixels, optional `maxHeight`, `format` jpeg or webp, `quality` 1–100.
covers._comment: Q27: cover providers tried in this order, each with its own flag. Amazon has no API (may stop working); Google Books needs the GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY environment variable, hence off by default.

privacy._comment: Removal of a patron anonymizes it immediately (Q32/Q33); there is no retention timer.

security._commentUsers: Accounts are normally shared per role. passwordHash from `bun run auth:hash-password`; a plain `password` key is accepted with a warning. At least one active account must hold `admin`.

ui._comment: locale: a built-in language (en, it) or the code of a language pack in CONFIG_DIR/i18n/<code>/ (validated at startup, English fills the gaps). theme: the colour set; dashboard: the sections of the start page (quick actions always first), each true or false. Both are chosen in Administration → Appearance and language.
